  requests for emotional complexity and patcher constraints.

ledger.text: experience only if supported; otherwise narrative-only.

items.text: a tiny lizard that insists on sitting on the cleanest shelf
a crab that has somehow climbed into an empty basket
a bird that keeps stealing the healers' bandages
a frog that appears to be supervising the medicine table
a turtle that has chosen the doorway as its permanent residence

intro.name: The visitor
intro.text:
A small animal has wandered into the village hospital. It is {A}.
(Healer) notices it first. (Child) is delighted. An elder waiting for a routine checkup remarks that the visitor has better bedside manners than some people (elder.he/she) knows.
The animal is not injured, but it cannot remain among clean medical supplies. What should the healer do?

choices.label: Ask the children to help guide it safely outside.
Move it to a suitable outdoor spot personally.

text_only.reason: narrative: says no one is hurt

k1.text: The children calmly guide the animal away from the hospital. The healer praises their patience.

k2.text: The children are so enthusiastic that the animal escapes through the window before they begin.

k3.text: One child wants to keep it as a pet. The healer explains why a wild animal is usually better left in its own habitat.

k4.text: The animal crawls into the child's empty sandal. The sandal is carefully carried outside.

h1.text: The healer gently moves the visitor outdoors, then cleans the affected work area.

h2.text: The animal evades capture with surprising agility. The elder gives directions from a chair like a battlefield commander.

h3.text: A nursing mother visiting with her infant points out an open door the healer overlooked. The animal leaves on its own.

h4.text: The healer discovers that the "animal" is a beautifully carved wooden toy. The children have been playing a joke.

e1.text: The hospital returns to its normal routine. The children learn to respect both animals and clean medical spaces.

e2.text: The elder asks whether the animal will be receiving a bill. The healer replies that it left before registering.

e3.text: A child makes a drawing of the visitor and gives it to the hospital. The healer hangs it where it won't interfere with care.

e4.text: The healer quietly thanks everyone for helping.
